collection.description: A child interrupts a solemn ceremony to ask a loud but innocent question.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) interrupts a solemn ceremony to ask a loud but innocent question.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) gives a quiet answer and returns to the ceremony.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) whispers a follow-up and waits patiently.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (adult), a teacher, explains that this moment calls for quiet and answers afterward.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) practices choosing a better moment without feeling ashamed.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a caregiver, answers the question away from the gathering.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) remembers and answers it after the ceremony.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) draws the question so it will not be forgotten.
